senses.sense_definition: A small dark spot or bump on the skin caused by a clogged pore.

examples.text: She bought a special facial cleanser designed to clear <w>blackheads</w> and prevent acne.
He noticed a stubborn <w>blackhead</w> on the side of his nose while looking in the mirror.

senses.sense_definition: A scaup, a kind of diving duck of the genus Aythya.

examples.text: The birdwatcher spotted a <w>blackhead</w> resting among the reeds near the lake shore.
Flocks of migrating <w>blackheads</w> were seen resting on the bay during early winter.

senses.sense_definition: A disease in poultry caused by a protozoan parasite, causing tissue damage and dark discoloration of the head.

examples.text: The poultry farmer took precautions to protect the flock from an outbreak of <w>blackhead</w>.
Turkeys infected with <w>blackhead</w> often show signs of lethargy and facial discoloration.
